import json,os
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import deque
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r), key=lambda v:[r.count(v) for r in g].__len__()) if False else None
    # background = most frequent value
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx]==col:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append((col,cells))
    def sil(cells):
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
        s=[[' ']*w for _ in range(h)]
        for y,x in cells: s[y-min(ys)][x-min(xs)]='#'
        return tuple(''.join(r) for r in s)
    groups={}
    for i,(col,cells) in enumerate(comps): groups.setdefault(sil(cells),[]).append(i)
    # key color: color with exactly one comp of size>=2 whose sil is unique (no twin)... fallback: comp size>=2, single-comp color
    from collections import defaultdict
    bycolor=defaultdict(list)
    for i,(col,cells) in enumerate(comps): bycolor[col].append(i)
    cand=[col for col,idxs in bycolor.items() if sum(1 for i in idxs if len(comps[i][1])>=2)==1
          and any(len(comps[i][1])>=2 for i in idxs)]
    # prefer the candidate whose silhouette is unique (not in any dup group) and is a bar+stem (largest such)
    def uniq(col):
        i=[i for i in bycolor[col] if len(comps[i][1])>=2][0]
        return len(groups[sil(comps[i][1])])==1
    cand=[c for c in cand if uniq(c)]
    keycol=max(cand,key=lambda c:len(comps[[i for i in bycolor[c] if len(comps[i][1])>=2][0]][1])) if cand else None
    # find different-color twin pairs, take largest
    pairs=[]
    for k,idxs in groups.items():
        cols=set(comps[i][0] for i in idxs)
        if len(idxs)>=2 and len(cols)>1:

            return (min(ys),min(xs))
        tgt=min(best,key=pos)
